title: Search forgives a misspelled title
description: A viewer who misspells a title would still find it. PRODUCT.md promises search from a title's first letters (JS-327), not typo tolerance.
bringBack: Searches on the new server are seen finding nothing for titles the collection has, often enough to matter, once search from first letters is built.
notes: The ordering and 'why it matched' parts of #116 are planned on JS-327.
